subject: ready-for-life
standards: Manuel Academy Ready for Life elementary sequence — Grade 3
Ready for Life v1 safety, supervision, and no-shame policy reference
Manuel Academy RFL G3 Unit 2 — clothing care and readiness routines
instructions: Complete the task or its stated simulation alternative. Do not submit photos, recordings, addresses, account details, or private household information.
Learner completion never certifies a guardian-authority task; those tasks remain pending until a guardian attests.

learnerTasks.directions: Before choosing anything, check the weather for the next day.
learnerTasks.prompt: Describe what you noticed about the weather and name the one clothing layer it makes you add or leave out.

learnerTasks.directions: Put together the whole night-before routine in order: choose the outfit, check it is clean, set it out, then pack one bag item.
learnerTasks.prompt: I chose a full outfit that matches tomorrow's temperature and weather.

learnerTasks.directions: Put together the whole night-before routine in order: choose the outfit, check it is clean, set it out, then pack one bag item.
learnerTasks.prompt: I checked that every piece of the outfit is actually clean before setting it out.

learnerTasks.directions: Put together the whole night-before routine in order: choose the outfit, check it is clean, set it out, then pack one bag item.
learnerTasks.prompt: I set the outfit and shoes together on a chair or hook, not left in a pile.

learnerTasks.directions: Put together the whole night-before routine in order: choose the outfit, check it is clean, set it out, then pack one bag item.
learnerTasks.prompt: I packed one item I will need for the next day into my bag.

learnerTasks.directions: Complete the whole routine on your own, without being reminded, the night before the actual day.
learnerTasks.prompt: Record which part of the routine you did first and which you did last, and describe whether anyone reminded you to start or you started on your own.

learnerTasks.directions: Compare this morning to a morning when the routine was not done the night before.
learnerTasks.prompt: Describe one specific way this morning felt less rushed than a morning when you had to find your outfit and pack your bag after waking up.

learnerSuccessCriteria: Provide evidence that meets the stated Independence (unprompted start) criterion.
Provide evidence that meets the stated Weather-matched completeness criterion.
accommodations: Access supports may change format, pacing, quantity, setting, or response mode without changing the assessed objective.

provenance.unitObjective: How can the learner demonstrate the goals of Clothes and Getting Ready?
